render_flyaround_video: render a flyaround video of a 3D scene using a model and dataset with configurable camera trajectory
generate_eval_cameras: generate evaluation video cameras along a circular, figure-eight, or trefoil knot trajectory around a scene
extract_images_from_predictions: extract and process rendered images, masks, and depth maps from model predictions into visualizable tensors
stack_images_grid: stack multiple images into a grid layout for visualization with optional resizing
generate_prediction_videos: generate MP4 videos from a list of model predictions and optionally display them in Visdom
